business_requirements.user_story: As a driver, I see generic text stating that CPF/Medisave deductions are not part of the fare calculation on the Bid, OTW, and Summary screens.
As a driver, I see an informative 'i' icon on the daily earnings page with a banner explaining the CPF/Medisave contribution.
As a driver, my order history / income summary page shows the Medisave/CPF contribution.

prerequisites: SG driver with CPF/Medisave deductions applied

business_requirements.user_story: As a driver, my monthly statement shows the actual amount deducted, the original amount deducted, the refund, and the configurable Gojek contribution rate.
As a driver, I automatically receive my monthly statement each month.
As a driver, my annual statement includes a CPF section and the company name.
As a driver, my CPF wallet shows the transaction history for both credit and debit transactions.

prerequisites: SG driver with a CPF wallet

boundary_conditions.edge_case_description: CPF deduction formula = Gross Earning * 40% (configurable) * deduction rate based on the bracket; applies to trip earnings, incentives, and tips.
boundary_conditions.proposed_default: Test with the configurable 40% and bracket-based rate across trip earnings, incentives, and tips.

boundary_conditions.edge_case_description: Cash transactions can drive the CPF wallet to a negative balance.
boundary_conditions.proposed_default: Negative balance is accepted by the business for cash transactions; assert it is allowed.
Assert against the configured value (3.5% default), never a hardcoded amount.

boundary_conditions.edge_case_description: Deduction start point differs for new vs existing drivers.
boundary_conditions.proposed_default: New drivers: from the 1st order; existing drivers: 1st order after auto-deduction is enabled. Test both.

boundary_conditions.edge_case_description: Monthly statement format is 'to be finalized'.
boundary_conditions.proposed_default: Flag to Product; statement layout is TBD.

out_of_scope_module: Driver opt-in integration (SG govt server / govt-id sync) [Backend]
Auditing business portal (CSV export for finance) [Backend/Web + Ops]
Manual finance audit columns (yellow-marked, handled outside the system)

rollout_plan.timeline: Dev complete 2nd week Sep; Pod QA by end Sep; E2E QA by 2nd week Oct; rollout from 3rd week Oct; hard deadline 1 Nov

feature_flags: UI toggle to enable CPF/Medisave changes (Android)
UI toggle to enable CPF/Medisave changes (iOS)
